generations.text: Nadia Natarajan contacted support because the Aero 2 stops charging after a few minutes since 2026-01-04. It is a High priority case and the status is currently Working. The agent offered a repair of $120.00. The knowledge base notes that Pulse Band step counts are recalibrated after a 2-day wear period.

Use only the case, its comments and the knowledge passages below.
